svg.title: Same pixels, two machine-readable outlines
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Same pixels, two machine-readable outlines” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. One browser layout with header, nav, main, aside and footer produces two different trees: a crossed-out tree of nested divs that a screen reader announces as group, group, group, and a green tree of header, nav, main, article, aside and footer announced as banner, navigation, main, article, complementary, contentinfo. Below, a parser tape stalls for 120 ms at a blocking script, reaching domInteractive at 137.4 ms, against the same tape with defer reaching it at 2.4 ms.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
